chapter: Warren and the Young family show
title: Willis Young's show comes to Warren and he recruits local boys
summary: Lester Young's father, called Billy Young in show business, closes his show in Warren, spots promise in Phillips, and gathers about ten local players including Pete Jones and Phillips's brother Clarence.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Everybody called him Billy, yeah, in show

business. His show closed in my home, and he went up there, and he stayed there, in a big auditorium there, and he used to put on a show, say, twice the week -- maybe the first of the week and Friday he'd put on a show. And he used to... I got talkin' with him, and he told me to come up, he wanted to talk with me. He said, "I think you got some promise in making a musician." So I said, "Okay." That knocked me out, you know. I mean, I was lookin', because I wanted to advance myself.
A trombonist. Pete Jones and my brother...
Clarence. And several other guys around there. And we got the band... We got about ten pieces together. And he started rehearsing us.
Willis Young got all those people from Warren.
Yeah, everybody from Warren. Oh, no. Not him.
Oh, this was not Willis Young?
No, this... Yeah, I'm getting myself mixed up. Yeah, we would go up to his place, and he would talk to us, you know. He'd tell us all about music, what he did. He did...
